## Today's learning {#ss3-objective .ap-lesson}

### Lesson objective

Understand how a constant difference connects an arithmetic sequence's recursive rule, general term and graph.

### Success criteria

I can identify arithmetic sequences and use their general term to find terms, test membership and solve problems.

::: notes

Students already know sequence notation, recursive rules and partial sums. The opening revisits these ideas through differences; no additional function-notation recap is needed.

:::
